question: A retailer marks a washing machine 60% above its cost price. He offers a first discount of 20% on the marked price. During a special sale, an additional discount of 15% is applied on the already discounted price. If the final selling price is 13,600, what is the cost price of the washing machine?

Marked price = 60% above cost price

First discount = 20%

Additional discount = 15%

Final selling price = 13,600
